# Mantra Sports Canada

> Mantra Sports Canada (www.mantrasports.ca) is the wholesale and B2B enquiry site for Mantra Sports cricket equipment in Canada. It serves cricket clubs, academies, schools, universities and retailers. There is no online checkout on this site: orders are by quote.

## What we supply
- English willow cricket bats (Players’ Grade to Grade III): Magnitude, Raptor and Cobra ranges
- Protective gear: batting gloves, leg guards, thigh guards, helmets, wicket-keeping gloves
- Leather cricket balls (red, white, pink, yellow)
- Performance sportswear for teams
- Accessories: grips, kit bags, stumps, training gear

## How to order
- Wholesale enquiry form: https://www.mantrasports.ca/wholesale
- B2B partnerships: https://www.mantrasports.ca/b2b
- Become a dealer: https://www.mantrasports.ca/become-a-dealer
- Phone (North America sales): +1 (385) 601-3759
- WhatsApp: +1 (267) 901-6382

## Key facts
- B2B and wholesale only in Canada; quotes for bulk, club and dealer orders
- Manufacturing defects are replaced
- Related stores: Mantra Sports Australia (https://mantrasports.com.au) and Mantra Sports USA (https://www.mantrasportsusa.com), which sell to consumers online
